scope: Offline native reference, controller progress and MPPI recovery audit. No ROS nodes, CAN, enable, reset or motion commands were started.

confirmed_fixed_defect.mechanism: All three stale native progress statuses previously emitted tracking_fault=True after a command for this goal had been delivered. Planner treats that as excessive tracking error, cancels the reference and replans, although source age alone does not invalidate the spatial path.
confirmed_fixed_defect.implementation: Classify native_progress_stale, native_progress_stale_during_plan and native_progress_stale_before_delivery as exact local retry reasons. Zero base and no arm command remain mandatory. No artificial progress stamp, timeout extension, hold heartbeat, fault clear or geometry bypass.
confirmed_fixed_defect.before: The real Adapter->WholeBodyNode cycle with progress stamp 99.7 and current time 100.0 emits zero base and tracking_fault=True. Regression failed before production edit.
confirmed_fixed_defect.after: Same stale cycle emits zero base, no arm and no tracking fault. A fresh valid progress sample resumes the identical native object/revision, through normal delivery validation. Only successful delivery publishes fault=False.
confirmed_fixed_defect.historical_attribution_limit: Nov10 17:18 post-restart navigation record contains zero stale-progress events; this defect must not be described as the cause of all historic stop-go motion.

validation.command: PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest test_mppi_collision test_mppi_native_phase test_mppi_reference_wait test_mppi_rejection_diagnostics -v

known_unmodified_coupling_limits.finding: Controller slows/freezes the common virtual phase when actual arm differs from slow native reference by >=0.25 rad and resumes only <=0.06 rad. It does not distinguish intentional MPPI avoidance from tracking error. A sustained large arm-only deviation can therefore eventually slow/stop nominal base progress.
known_unmodified_coupling_limits.risk_of_naive_fix: Removing the hold without an approved safe MPPI deviation signal also removes protection against genuine actuator tracking failure.
known_unmodified_coupling_limits.status: Structural limitation, not established as observed historical cause; not changed.

planner_phase_fix.mechanism: At source expiry the slow planner used to jump from virtual controller phase to elapsed wall time. A slow/paused five-second curve could instantly appear finished. Local replan would additionally predict forward with scale 1 while the MPPI side had already stopped on stale progress.
planner_phase_fix.change: Matched but expired progress now retains the bounded reported phase and returns zero scale. More than 5 ms future progress also cannot extrapolate forward. Fresh matching progress resumes normally. Missing or different trajectory progress preserves legacy fallback.
planner_phase_fix.downstream_review: EXEC_TRAJ completion and static trajectory scanning retain the reported phase. Local handoff no longer extrapolates missing progress. Dynamic prediction independently checks matching source freshness when dynamic points are present; actual robot collision checks and MPPI command input expiry remain active. No timestamp restamping or timeout extension.
planner_phase_fix.validation: 7 compiled-fixture tests pass. Fixture extracts exact production C++ methods and links real ros::Time; no ROS graph or controller is started. Covers stale/long-gap/paused/future cases, 0.5 s boundary, new feedback recovery and unchanged no-match behavior.
planner_phase_fix.production_build: Pending root single-object rebuild and atomic planner executable installation at time of this report.
